thread:
tess: Heads-up: found a class of undercount in billing previews when late-enrich events arrive after per-tenant sampling. Repro steps below.

omar: Oof. Is this the same late-enrich we saw with kv-cache misses last quarter?

felix: Possibly related but the pattern looks different. Repro: 1) tenant has sampling=low (10%) 2) event emitted without route_resolution_id 3) later async enrich resolves route and emits a paired event with same session_id but different event_id 4) preview pipeline dedupes by event_id so second event adds tokens but sampling logic had already dropped first path in aggregator -> net undercount in preview vs ledger.

tess: Exact. So invoice-preview shows fewer tokens than ledger for sampled tenants. Ledger is eventual-consistent and gets both tokens. Preview uses sampled stream and relies on dedupe by event_id which misses the linked enrichment.

omar: Two orthogonal fixes: A) make preview join tolerant to linked enrichs by using session_id join when event_id not matched, or B) ensure enrich replays use same event_id (canonicalize) so dedupe works.

felix: Option B is preferable for simplicity: if enrich step knows the original event_id it should emit with `orig_event_id` and the ledger/preview should treat `event_id || orig_event_id` as the dedupe key. Changing event_id in enrich might be risky though for downstream consumers.

tess: UX impact: some SEs rely on event_id as immutable. We can't mutate it. But adding `orig_event_id` and having dedupe logic consult both is OK. Need backward compat for older ledger readers.

billing-bot: alert: tenant-delta-checker reported a 0.72% median undercount for sample=low tenants in last 2h at 1763141200.

omar: 0.72% is above our preview-noise guard. Proposed rollout plan:
- patch preview aggregator to consult `orig_event_id` fallback for 7d window
- add `enrich.linked` metric when enrich emits with `orig_event_id` vs not
- run a 24h shadow comparing preview-agg with ledger totals for sampled tenants

felix: Implementation detail: preview service currently indexes by event_id -> tokens. We'll need to create a side-index session_id -> event_ids for a short TTL to catch late-linked enrichs. That side-index can be maintained in memory + persistent cache (redis).

tess: Risk: double-counting if both original and enrich emit with same tokens and we accidentally sum. Dedupe order matters. We'll define dedupe precedence: if `orig_event_id` present, treat the enrich as a superset replacement of original. In other words mark original as superseded and replace tokens atomically.

omar: We must add an integration test that replays these sequences: (a) sampled drop then enrich, (b) enrich first then sampled, (c) both present simultaneously, and assert preview == ledger within 0.05%.

felix: Telemetry: add `preview.linked_replace.count`, `preview.linked_replace.failures`, and `preview.sideindex.hit_rate`. Alert if `preview.linked_replace.failures` > 10 in 15m.

billing-bot: note: customers flagged in last rollout: tenant-42 and tenant-77 experiencing about ~1% drift, billing team notified.

tess: Rollout steps:
1) patch preview aggregator with `orig_event_id` fallback + side-index (canary 5% sample of tenants, flag gated)
2) enable shadow mode for 48h and collect diffs
3) if median diff < 0.3% and duplicates < threshold, enable for 25%
4) full cutover after 72h stable

omar: Also add a console diff-tool for SEs: show line-by-line preview vs ledger with glue fields (event_id, orig_event_id, session_id, route_resolution_id). That will help debug support tickets.

felix: Edge change: encourage enrich to emit `orig_event_id` where possible. We'll update the enrich contract in the API changelog and clientlib. Add header `x-enrich-has-orig: 1` when included.

rollout-bot: canary-deploy started for preview-sideindex patch at 1763141400.

tess: Action items:
- felix: PR for preview-sideindex and dedupe precedence, include unit+integration tests (due Thu EOD)
- omar: dashboard panels + alerts for the three new metrics (due Thu EOD)
- tess: runbook + console diff tool mockups (due Fri AM)
- felix/ingest: update enrich pipeline to emit `orig_event_id` when available and add header (coord with ingest team)

felix: One more gotcha: exporting invoice-preview diffs to finance exports will change shape. Add migration note and keep export schema backward-compatible by adding optional columns instead of renaming.

billing-bot: scheduled a billing sync with finance at 1763142000 to walk through diffs.

omar: Thanks team. If we see a spike in `preview.sideindex.evictions` we may need to bump TTL or increase memory on aggregator.

tess: I'll post the canary dashboard link once the PR lands. Thanks all.
